text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre, who became a magnificent Triple Crown Umamusume.
The legacy she left behind is truly magnificent—
choice_data_list: (There's no other Uma Musume like her!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wanting to do something to celebrate Orfevre's great achievement... just as I was pondering it, I received a summons from Orfevre herself—
choice_data_list: (This is my chance! I've got to do my best to respond...!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Bring forth the star.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It's a star.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There must be plenty in the sky.
The brightest one would be best.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Begin at once.
Adorn my castle with stars.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Expedition Support Committee room where Dream Journey belongs...
has practically turned into Orfevre's stronghold.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She makes all kinds of unreasonable demands daily, but...
this time, the scale is far beyond reason.
What's more, judging by her expression—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What is the matter?
Go.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
—Hey.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, today is...
'Absolute Monarchy Day.'

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Or is a king, so she carries herself
with carefree ease at all times.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Combine that with her innate knack
for sweet-talking people as a "little sister," and—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
After the stars...
maybe I'll sleep in the galaxy next.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Tell me, isn't it magnificent?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
On days when Or is in an especially good mood,
I playfully call it the "Day of Absolute Monarchy."
choice_data_list: (...I can't even keep up with all the comebacks!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In the past, a golden throne was requested.
My father and I worked frantically to make it a reality.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"No, not at all.
If anything, I'm grateful."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Because I get to grant
Or's supreme selfishness, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's time to show off what
we've honed over these three years.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The star desired by the King...
Please, offer it up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even if asked... physically speaking, it's impossible to bring down a real star right now. However, I truly want to grant it as much as I can.
choice_data_list: (I mean, Orfe is just too amazing!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As a Triple Crown Umamusume,
she achieved feats rivaling the legendary greats of the past.
She is truly—a legend."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Right this moment, at 'that place'—a special feature on legendary Umamusume should be underway. Naturally... the King is among them as well."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —And then?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I sent the stars to my castle, yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The place we arrived at was... the first place I ever went together with Orfevre. The museum where she boldly proclaimed she would become a Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Back then, she saw the exhibition of legendary Umamusume. But now she is no longer on the viewing side—she is the one being watched.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...A bust, of me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside the legendary Umamusume that
Orfevre once glared down upon... a bust of
her own had now been added to the row.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I see.
You really racked your brains over that one.
choice_data_list: I'm shining the brightest, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Cunning fellow.
However—not bad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Laughing like that, Orfevre gazes upon her own monumental feat.
The trail of light she blazes will surely continue to shine brightly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In addition to the Classic Triple Crown... Orfevre won the Senior Triple Crown races as well, brilliantly becoming a Double Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To truly honor someone like her,
perhaps nothing short of an actual star
would ever suffice.
choice_data_list: (How to bring the stars in the sky down to earth—)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah-hah-ha!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Rob Roy-kun!!
More! Make it flow even more, please!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's the recreation of the comet! It's a crucial scene announcing the hero's death to the people, after all!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
Um, just like the stars...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching the two of them gave me an idea. Stars aren't only in the sky—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —So, where are the stars?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Outside?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...!
This is—

text_block_list.name: Vassals & Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre~~!!
Orfeeeee!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swaying below are countless penlights from Orfevre's subjects and fans.
They looked just like stars shining upon the earth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To honor Orfevre's great achievement and grant her wish... Many of those who looked up to her agreed to that request.
choice_data_list: Every star is dedicated to you
Every single star is dedicated to you

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I see.
choice_data_list: Each and every feeling is shining bright, isn't it?
Each and every feeling is shining bright, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...It's a mediocre idea.
However..."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I want to see the view from the residential castle as well. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre is arrogant and headstrong. But
these stars filled with her subjects' devotion...
seemed to be a more than fitting gift for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre claimed not only the Classic Triple Crown,
but also the Spring Senior Triple Crown consisting of the
Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), and Takarazuka Kinen, and furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because she accomplished the incomparable and
supreme feat of achieving the Autumn Senior Triple Crown
by winning the Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup, and Arima Kinen...!
choice_data_list: (I want to offer her a star worthy of her!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—At that moment, I suddenly wonder. For someone who has
achieved such an astounding record up to this point...
could there really be a star worthy of her?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: That's fast.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
While the sun is still up,
how did you manage to claim a star?
choice_data_list: The brightest star is right here.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Me, is it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You are right.
No star shines brighter than I.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However, I told you to "bring" me the stars.
What will you do?
choice_data_list: ...That's why I prepared something of equal value.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It's quite embarrassing to say what comes next. But... when looking for a star other than Orfevre, this was the only thing that came to mind."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If there is any star worthy of standing alongside Orfevre at the very pinnacle—it can only be me, as her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Haaah.
Talk about talking big.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
So you are the star.
Then...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I will make you shine forever within my universe.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
In their stead, line the wind, the sky, the light—
lay them all before Us.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Dedicate it.
Make them bow before you!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
After all—everything exists
simply to entertain me.
choice_data_list: (There's no other Uma Musume like her...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet precisely because of that—I am helplessly drawn to Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Very well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Strive well, and shine brightly—
As stars standing side-by-side with Us.
